text.aria-label: Title text 'CRPS at days 1 to 10, each arm minus its control (R; A for a pretrained arm), 4 folds. Dot: estimate. Line: 99.69% interval from resampling whole months (a description). Dashed line: same as the control. An interval that crosses it is inside the noise.'
text.tspan: CRPS at days 1 to 10, each arm minus its control (R; A for a pretrained arm), 4 folds.
Dot: estimate. Line: 99.69% interval from resampling whole months (a description).
Dashed line: same as the control. An interval that crosses it is inside the noise.
